headline: How to Get Sheldon
title: How to Get Sheldon in Aniimo | Shelly Evolution Level | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want Sheldon in Aniimo? You have two ways. The easy one is evolving Shelly. Shelly evolves at level twenty nine, and level is the only condition listed. Find Shelly around the beaches of Echoback Landing. You can also catch a wild Sheldon in the same area, but only a couple of spawn points are known on the north side beaches. Which way will you go? Comment below!
description: How to get Sheldon in Aniimo: evolve Shelly at level 29 or hunt the rare wild spawns on the beaches of Echoback Landing.
